rationale: The short thesis is mechanically intact — price remains in the lower quartile of the range, well below the 5-minute VWAP at 33.28, and the 32.79 invalidation has not been threatened after seven minutes of dead, low-range tape (MFE/MAE negligible). With 55 minutes to the close, the prior-close magnet at 31.68 is still reachable and risk from the current ask (~32.71) to the stop is only ~0.25% against a ~2.8% target, so exiting now would merely realize spread costs on an untriggered stop. A flip to long has no supporting evidence, as price has shown no break above the 32.65–32.79 shelf and sits below short-term VWAP.
